feeds.title: Ploeh Blog - Mark Seemann
feeds.description: Mark Seemann helps programmers make source code easier to maintain. Experienced programmer and international conference speaker, particularly interested in functional programming and object-oriented design with Haskell, F# and C#. Occasionally writes and speaks about various development topics.

feeds.title: Sergey Tihon's Blog
feeds.description: Sergey Tihon's blog is all about F# programming language.

feeds.title: Mathias Brandewinder Blog
feeds.description: Mathias Brandewinder has been developing software on .NET for about 10 years, and loving every minute of it, except maybe for a few release days. His language of choice was C#, until he discovered F# and fell in love with it. He enjoys arguing about code and how to make it better, and gets very excited when discussing TDD or F#.

feeds.title: Tomas Petricek's Blog
feeds.description: Tomas Petricek writes about software development in F# and .NET, sharing materials from his F# trainings and talks. Tomas Petricek's latest blog posts about programming languages and tools, working with data, philosophy of science and more.

feeds.title: Thinkbeforecoding - Jérémie Chassaing
feeds.description: Jérémie Chassaing is the author of thinkbeforecoding, a blog dedicated to Domain Driven Design, CQRS and Event Sourcing and the CTO of Siriona (the startup behind Availpro, a channel manager for independent hotels) where F# has proven very efficient to implement Domain Driven Design and Event Sourcing, using it in production for more that a year now to increase scalability and reliability to match the company's rapid growth.

feeds.title: Fsharp.org Blog
feeds.description: F# is a mature, open source, cross-platform, functional-first programming language. It empowers users and organizations to tackle complex computing problems with simple, maintainable and robust code.

feeds.title: Devon Burriss' Blog
feeds.description: An avid Domain-Driven Design practitioner and a closet functional-programmer, He spends free time writing F# code and planning how to sneak it into production.

feeds.title: Eirik Tsarpalis' blog
feeds.description: Eirik George Tsarpalis is software engineer at Jet Dublin, a mathematician and .NET developer who's been writing F# for the past 6 years.

feeds.title: F# Scott Nimrod's Blog
feeds.description: Scott Nimrod is fascinated with software craftsmanship. He has been practicing software development since 2003. He is a thriving entrepreneur, software consultant, and he blogs.

feeds.title: WTF# - Stachu Korick
feeds.description: Curious as to what's happening in the F# ecosystem? Whether you're a long-time F# lover or functionally curious, this is a great means of keeping up to speed with functional programming on the .NET platform!

feeds.title: Geek, Eh Blog - Shane Charles
feeds.description: Shane Charles is a software developer who is passionate about learning and trying new things. He likes to be active in the technology communities. He is currently a Microsoft MVP, mainly due to blogging and talking about F#.

feeds.title: Demystify FP - Tamizhvendan S Blog
feeds.description: Tamizhvendan S is a Full-Stack solution provider and has a wealth of experience in solving complex problems using different programming languages and technologies. F#, Clojure & Haskell are some of his favourites.
